Definition: from a derivative of G700; complaisance:--pleasing.
BiblicalUsage: The word is pleasing, complaisance, and it appears once, when Paul prays that the Colossians will walk worthy of the Lord unto all pleasing, being fruitful in every good work.
TheologicalSignificance: A life that pleases the Lord is a life that bears fruit, and the two cannot be separated.
